source.title: 2026 Fantasy Football: Jayden Reed among Justin Boone's top sleeper picks at WR
source.author: Justin Boone

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone considers Shaheed a strong late value with WR3/flex utility and spike-week upside.
takeaways.rationale: A full offseason in Seattle and positive usage reports give him a path to the No. 2 receiver role behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba.
risks: Jaxon Smith-Njigba commands the passing game
Cooper Kupp and Tory Horton still compete for snaps and targets

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone sees Downs as an undervalued WR4 with room to become a more meaningful fantasy weapon.
takeaways.rationale: Michael Pittman's departure opens targets, the Colts may expand Downs' perimeter role, and Downs has produced well with competent quarterback play.
risks: His smaller frame has historically limited his role
Alec Pierce, Tyler Warren, and Keenan Allen compete for targets

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone rates Reed as a WR4/flex with upside now that Green Bay has clearer opportunity behind Christian Watson.
takeaways.rationale: Reed has already shown a high fantasy ceiling, while receiver departures and Tucker Kraft's injury recovery create a path to more work.
risks: A full-time role in two-receiver sets is not guaranteed

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Boone calls McMillan a major late-round value with a meaningful role available in Tampa Bay.
takeaways.rationale: McMillan flashed league-winning production late in his rookie year and returned with a strong game after a serious 2025 neck injury.
risks: Emeka Egbuka and Chris Godwin remain ahead of him
His 2025 season was largely lost to a serious injury
